list.title: Clients
list.descriptionAdmin: Everyone your organization collects documents from.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by first name, last name or company

empty.searchDescription: Try a different name or company.
empty.noneDescription: Add your first client to start collecting documents.

form.description: Only the first and last name are required. A client is a person with an optional company.

placeholders.email: Needed for the client portal and reminders
placeholders.companyInfo: e.g. Industry, contact person, anything useful to know

form.sendInvitationHint: Email the client an invitation to the client portal. Requires an email address.
form.assignedEmployeesHint: Every selected employee can see and work with this client. Owners and Admins always have access.
form.noAssignPermission: You are assigned to clients you create. Ask an Admin to add colleagues.

invite.label: Invite to the client portal now
invite.emailHint: The client can activate their portal from the email.
invite.otherwise: Otherwise they are invited when you assign their first form.

attention.rejectedWaiting: Rejected — waiting for a new upload

progress.title: Overall collection progress
progress.noForms: No forms assigned yet. Assign a form to start collecting documents.

allCaughtUp.title: All caught up
allCaughtUp.description: No missing, expired or pending documents for this client.

detail.noAssignees: No one assigned (Owners and Admins can see this client)

portal.title: Client portal
portal.notInvited: Not invited yet. The client is invited automatically when you assign their first form.
portal.noEmail: Add an email address to invite this client to the portal.

forms.emptyDescription: Assign a document form to start collecting from this client.

notes.internalOnly: Internal notes are only visible to your team.

archive.restoreDescription: The client becomes active again and automatic reminders resume.
archive.archiveDescription: Archived clients are hidden from lists and stop receiving automatic reminders. Their documents and history are kept.

delete.title: Delete this client?
delete.description: The client is removed from all lists and can no longer use the portal. This cannot be undone from the app.

employeesDialog.description: Every selected employee can see and work with this client.

import.title: Import clients
import.uploadDescription: Upload an Excel or CSV file. You will match its columns to client fields next.
import.mapDescription_one: Choose which client field each column feeds. {{count}} row will be imported.
import.mapDescription_other: Choose which client field each column feeds. {{count}} rows will be imported.
import.hint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 5 MB and 2,000 rows. The first row must contain column names.
import.nameRequired: Map a full name column, or both a first name and a last name column.
import.skipDuplicates: Skip rows whose email already exists

result.summary: {{total}} rows read · {{skipped}} duplicates skipped · {{failed}} could not be imported

invite.hint: Invite the {{count}} new clients to their portal by email.

problem.SINGLE_WORD_NAME: “{{value}}” is only one word. Both a first and a last name are needed.
problem.INVALID_EMAIL: “{{value}}” in column “{{column}}” isn’t a valid email address.
problem.INVALID_COUNTRY: “{{value}}” in column “{{column}}” isn’t a country we recognise. Use a country name or 2-letter code, like Greece or GR.
problem.TOO_LONG: The value in column “{{column}}” is too long to be saved as “{{field}}”.
problem.INVALID: “{{value}}” in column “{{column}}” can’t be used as “{{field}}”.

reason.DUPLICATE_EXISTING: A client with the email {{email}} already exists.
reason.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: The email {{email}} appears earlier in the file, so this row was skipped.

warning.title: Please double-check the column mapping
warning.EMAIL_COLUMN_NOT_EMAILS: Only {{valid}} of {{total}} values in column “{{column}}” look like email addresses (for example “{{example}}”). Is this the right column for “{{field}}”?
warning.LOOKS_LIKE_EMAIL: Column “{{column}}” looks like it contains email addresses, but it is set to import as “{{field}}”. Did you mean “Email”?
warning.footer: Nothing has been imported yet. Change the mapping above, or import anyway.
